label: Diagram 2.24
caption: Diagram 2.24 Wall type 2 – internal concrete floor and concrete ground floor
description: This is a section drawing, labelled "SECTION" at the bottom right, below the heading "Diagram 2.24 Wall type 2 – internal concrete floor and concrete ground floor", which sits in a box at the top of the image. A single vertical wall runs up the centre of the image, drawn as two parallel columns of masonry: cross‑hatched block courses at the top, a break, then horizontal brick courses below, terminating in a solid concrete foundation block at the base. The wall passes through two horizontal floor levels. The upper floor is a thick concrete slab spanning both sides of the wall, labelled "Internal concrete floor". At a lower level, the left‑hand slab is labelled "Concrete slab ground floor", shown as a solid concrete piece, while the right‑hand slab is labelled "Suspended concrete ground floor" and contains a row of evenly spaced circles within it. The right‑hand suspended floor is drawn slightly higher than the left‑hand slab. A "Ground" label appears at the bottom left and a second one at the bottom right, but a horizontal line indicating the ground level is drawn only on the right side, beneath the suspended floor; there is no such line on the left.
